name: Logistics
tagline: Turn disruption noise into coordinated, exception-aware execution.
overview: Carriers and 3PLs lose margin to reactive firefighting across tendering, tracking, and claims. Multi-agent systems can sense disruptions early and replan with human control on costly decisions.
painPoints: Dispatchers drown in exception emails and EDI noise
Tender acceptance is inconsistent across lanes and carriers
Claims and detention disputes lack assembled evidence
strategicImpact: Higher on-time performance with fewer manual touches
Faster claims packages with better recovery rates

singleAgents.name: Exception Radar
singleAgents.role: Detects delay risk and proposes recovery options
singleAgents.trigger: Tracking event gap or weather/port alert
singleAgents.roi: 15–30% fewer late deliveries from slow reaction

singleAgents.name: Tender Optimizer
singleAgents.role: Scores and responds to load tenders

singleAgents.name: Detention Watch Agent
singleAgents.role: Tracks dwell and prepares detention invoices/disputes
singleAgents.roi: Recovered accessorial revenue with less dispute churn

multiAgent.name: Control Tower Crew
multiAgent.description: A supervisor-led team that owns in-transit exceptions from detection through customer communication and replan.

supervisor.name: Control Tower Supervisor
supervisor.responsibilities: Owns shipment risk posture, chooses recovery strategy, and decides when to escalate to human dispatch.
supervisor.routingLogic: Sensor anomaly → Tracking Agent; capacity conflict → Relane Agent; customer impact → Comms Agent; cost tradeoff → Pricing Agent.

multiAgent.conflictResolution: High-cost replans require human dispatcher approval; conflicting ETA sources prefer telemetry over EDI; repeated customer commitments create locked constraints.

workflow.label: Input
workflow.description: Ingest tracking pings, appointment windows, and contract SLAs.

workflow.label: Reason
workflow.description: Supervisor diagnoses root cause and ranks recovery strategies.

workflow.label: Tool Execution
workflow.description: Agents replan lanes, update TMS, and prepare customer communications.

workflow.label: Human-in-the-Loop
workflow.description: Dispatcher approves costly swaps or customer-sensitive commitments.

workflow.label: Output
workflow.description: Shipment plan updated; stakeholders notified; metrics logged.
